fixes.title: No Product structured data
fixes.fix: Add Product JSON-LD with name, image and offers (price, priceCurrency, availability).

fixes.title: No BreadcrumbList markup
fixes.fix: Add BreadcrumbList structured data mirroring the visible breadcrumb trail.

fixes.title: Product description is thin
fixes.fix: Write a unique description covering materials, size, use cases and care; aim for 100+ words.

fixes.title: Product page is set to noindex
fixes.fix: Remove the noindex directive (meta robots or X-Robots-Tag) from sellable product pages.

fixes.title: Meta description missing
fixes.fix: Write a unique meta description of roughly 120-160 characters.

fixes.title: GTIN fails length or check-digit validation
fixes.fix: Correct the GTIN; it must be 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid check digit.

fixes.title: Parameter URL canonicalises to itself
fixes.fix: Point faceted, sorted and tracking URLs at the clean URL, or noindex them.

fixes.title: priceCurrency missing
fixes.fix: Add offers.priceCurrency as an ISO 4217 code such as BDT or USD.

fixes.title: Offer price is not a valid number
fixes.fix: Use a plain decimal number without currency symbols or thousands separators.

fixes.title: Visible price differs from structured-data price
fixes.fix: Make sure the structured-data price is the same price a shopper sees (watch for cached or tax-inclusive values).

fixes.title: aggregateRating has no ratingCount or reviewCount
fixes.fix: Add ratingCount or reviewCount to aggregateRating.

fixes.title: aggregateRating has an invalid ratingValue
fixes.fix: Provide a numeric ratingValue within the worstRating..bestRating range.

fixes.title: Availability markup disagrees with page text
fixes.fix: Drive the availability markup and the on-page stock message from the same stock status.

fixes.title: Meta description is shared with other pages
fixes.fix: Write unique meta descriptions or let a template include the product name and attributes.

fixes.title: Title is shared with other pages
fixes.fix: Make titles unique: product name, key attribute and brand.

fixes.title: Unrecognised availability value
fixes.fix: Use a schema.org ItemAvailability URL, for example https://schema.org/InStock.

fixes.title: Brand missing
fixes.fix: Add brand (a Brand object with name) to the Product markup.

fixes.title: No canonical URL
fixes.fix: Add a self-referencing rel=canonical to every indexable page.

fixes.title: Invalid hreflang language/region code
fixes.fix: Use ISO 639-1 language codes with optional ISO 3166-1 region, e.g. en-GB, or x-default.

fixes.title: hreflang URL is not absolute
fixes.fix: Use fully qualified URLs in hreflang annotations.

fixes.title: Low image alt-text coverage
fixes.fix: Add descriptive alt text to product images (name, colour, angle).

fixes.title: Paginated page canonicalises to page 1
fixes.fix: Give each paginated page a self-referencing canonical so products on later pages stay discoverable.

fixes.title: priceValidUntil is in the past
fixes.fix: Update priceValidUntil to a future date or generate it dynamically.

fixes.title: Review markup count exceeds the aggregateRating count
fixes.fix: Make reviewCount/ratingCount at least as large as the number of marked-up reviews.

fixes.title: Review is missing author or rating
fixes.fix: Each Review needs an author and reviewRating.ratingValue.

fixes.title: No shipping or return policy markup
fixes.fix: Add shippingDetails and hasMerchantReturnPolicy to the Offer for merchant listing features.

fixes.title: Product description missing in markup
fixes.fix: Add a description property to the Product markup.

fixes.title: More than one H1 heading
fixes.fix: Use a single H1 per page.

fixes.title: priceValidUntil missing
fixes.fix: Add offers.priceValidUntil (ISO 8601 date) so price snippets stay eligible.

fixes.title: No x-default hreflang
fixes.fix: Consider adding an x-default for visitors who match no listed locale.
